defs.def: the male ruler of a small country or state that has a royal family; a male member of this family, especially the son or grandson of the ruler （小国的）国王，王室的男性成员，王子，王孙

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 想到讲故事，你脑海中浮现的第一件事，或许是爸妈用各自的嗓音为你讲王子、城堡和怪兽的故事时，你心中形成的幻想世界。

ex.s: So, if you want to see a show that combines music, singing, drama, poetry and costume design with explosive effect, The Revenge of Prince Zidan ticks all the right boxes!
ex.t: 所以，如果你想看一场将音乐、歌唱、戏剧、诗歌和服装设计与震撼效果相结合的演出，《子丹王子复仇记》绝对符合你的所有期待！
